name: Holodeck · Composer
actions: edit a friendly subset of Echo Atrium world data
compile edits into an immediate screen preview
try the draft through bounded human intents
switch to a read-only observer camera without changing world history
orbit, raise, lower, zoom, or choose observer viewpoints
explicitly save or load a browser-local draft
download a canonical world JSON draft
summary: A human-facing workbench for changing selected Holodeck world data, compiling it immediately, and switching between history-changing player control and a read-only observer camera.
notes: Local draft editor only. It does not import arbitrary worlds, promote canonical data, edit all contracts, or claim VR, hologram, or physical manipulation support.
